hypotheses.claim: The own-reset derivative terms in SCAR-X35 may attenuate or misalign delayed local eligibility relative to a stopped-reset approximation. Same forward spikes and matched applied update norm can distinguish a credit-path effect from a larger-step effect.
hypotheses.novelty: Known approximation choice, not a new e-prop invention; task utility is unproven.

hypotheses.claim: With the unchanged public lexical/hash encoder, some fact/scoping paraphrases may remain poorly separated despite no exact collisions. A source-blind fixed-feature diagnostic can separate encoding/readout limits from hidden training failure before any new codec or learner.
hypotheses.novelty: Causal diagnostic, not a new architecture. No learned embedding, fact-ID input or answer lookup.
